meta.title: Medical Disclaimer — Getmeds
meta.description: Getmeds medical information disclaimer and emergency health advice notice.

sections.title: Not Professional Medical Advice
sections.content: The information provided on Getmeds website is for informational and educational purposes only and is not intended as a substitute for advice from your physician or other healthcare professional.

sections.title: Emergency Medical Conditions
sections.content: Do not use Getmeds website for emergency medical needs. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, immediately call your doctor, dial emergency services (911/117), or go to the nearest hospital emergency room.

sections.title: Prescription Compliance
sections.content: All prescription products require a valid prescription issued by a licensed physician in the Philippines.
